name: 混沌之矛
description: 对4格内一名敌人造成50%攻击力的物理伤害，并偷取其2点移动范围至己方下回合开始。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,t=selectTarget({type:'piece',range:4,filter:'enemy'});if(!t||t.needsTargetSelection)return t;var old=(c.statusTags||[]).find(function(tag){return tag.type==='chaos-spear-theft';});if(old)return {success:false,message:'混沌之矛的移速偷取尚未归还'};var r=dealDamage(c,t,Math.floor(c.attack*0.5),'physical',context.battle,context.skill.id);t.moveRange=(t.moveRange||0)-2;c.moveRange=(c.moveRange||0)+2;c.statusTags=c.statusTags||[];c.statusTags.push({id:'chaos-spear-theft-'+c.instanceId+'-'+t.instanceId,type:'chaos-spear-theft',name:'混沌之矛',targetId:t.instanceId,intensity:2,currentDuration:-1,relatedRules:['rule-shadow-chaos-spear-restore']});addRuleById(c.instanceId,'rule-shadow-chaos-spear-restore');return {success:true,message:'造成'+r.damage+'点伤害并偷取2点移动范围'};}
